description: A developer reply draft for one review, in the storefront's language. The review's rating and text come from the stored review on our side, so the draft answers what the reviewer actually wrote; `note` adds what you want the reply to say (a fix shipped, a setting to try). The draft is returned only — reply_review posts a reply after your confirmation. Uses one Review AI credit.

country.description: country code, e.g. tr, us (defaults to the app's first country)

note.description: what the reply should say, e.g. fixed in 2.4.1

reviewId.description: review id from get_reviews or search_reviews

name: draft_review_reply
